spec_extract_note: Extraction thresholds (#36), the same author's values the user kept for bench-k01-kpp1 on 2026-10-09; `dt spec extract --tolerances` reads them
geometry_source: HARNESS_PLAN §5 starting numbers for npm_min (bbox ±5 cm, levels ±3 cm, storey area ±2 %, silhouette IoU >= 0.97); triangles_max = standards/NPM_STANDARD.yaml oks_triangles_per_fbx_max; overlap_m = profile near_coplanar_spacing_m.min (5 mm); weld_m = the extractor's weld (0.1 mm). To be tuned after the first B01 / B02 runs (HARNESS_PLAN §11.5)
geometry_note: Storey area: outer area of horizontal sections at section_fractions of each storey, compared where both sections close. Silhouettes: front/back and left/right orthographic outlines are mirror images, so views x, y and top cover the 4 sides + top. Mesh: no edge of more than two faces; open edges only as the pattern roof-inset-plane allows and requires (user rules 2026-10-10, replace the 2026-10-09 report-only rule): the bottom ring and, per slab (the roof in a parapet, every terrace: required, a solid slab fails), exactly two closed loops: contour A (the foot of the parapet inner faces at LEVEL_roof) and contour B (the plane outline, roof_inset_gap_m 2-10 mm above it, embedded into the parapet faces: A grown by one even offset within roof_inset_embed_m, B02 20 mm; the 10 mm floor is the project's embed minimum, the 50 mm ceiling a proposal); every other open loop fails; open_part_groups empty (no stand-alone parts); n-gons need `polygon_sizes` in the dump. Opening planes: kinds checked (null = untyped); a grille is a texture in npm_min (pattern vent-grille) and is not checked Plates: each inset plate's gap and overlap equal the spec's plate_gap_m / plate_overlap_m within plate_tol_m (0.5 mm; building parameters, user 2026-10-10).
